  UNION SELECT concept_id FROM opioid_ingredients

        AND co.condition_start_date <= po.procedure_date
    )
), med_events AS (

  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  WHERE de.drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM med_concepts)
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
      WHERE co.person_id=de.person_id AND co.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM endo_concepts)

  SELECT person_id, index_date, treatment,

       SUM(opioid_12m) AS opioid_n,
       CAST(100.0*SUM(opioid_12m)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS DECIMAL(6,2)) AS opioid_pct
FROM outcomes
GROUP BY treatment
ORDER BY treatment
